info.description: The Food Delivery Driver Listing API provides a streamlined way to access and manage information about delivery drivers associated with food deliveries. This endpoint enables businesses to retrieve a list of active drivers, offering insights into their availability and performance metrics. The API is particularly useful for delivery management systems, restaurants, and logistics firms looking to optimize driver allocation and improve service efficiency. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications to better coordinate food delivery operations and manage resources effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the list of deliveries assigned to a specific driver, providing vital information for tracking and managing delivery operations efficiently.
